observations: Manual sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table with a metal treadle stand.
The brand 'MERCURY' is visible on a badge on the machine head.
The treadle footplate has 'SUMOPREMIUM' cast into it.
Significant paint chipping and wear are visible on the top right surface of the machine head in photos 0, 1, and 2.
The wooden table surface shows some scratches and edge wear.
No drive belt is visible connecting the large wheel to the machine head in photo 3.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show clear paint loss and chipping on the machine head housing.

risks.risk: Mechanical components may be seized or out of timing.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a line of stitches through two layers of fabric.

risks.risk: The drive belt may be missing or snapped.
risks.proof: A photo showing the belt installed and connecting the treadle wheel to the machine head.

risks.risk: Internal gears or the bobbin assembly may be rusted.
risks.proof: A video showing the handwheel turning smoothly and the needle bar moving without resistance.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing through fabric to prove mechanical function.
Close-up photo of the bobbin area under the slide plate.
response.reason: The item is a standard manual Mercury sewing machine on a Sumopremium stand. While the 'perfect condition' claim is false due to visible cosmetic wear, it is a complete unit that can be priced at its worst-case functional state.
